exact_problem: SMEs paid late by larger customers; staff time spent chasing; working capital locked

why_current_solutions_may_be_insufficien: Tools exist and are cheap; residual lateness is driven by payer power, not process

workflow: Retailer deductions & chargebacks (US mid-market CPG brands)
exact_problem: Retailers deduct from remittances for shortages, compliance fines and promotions; a share is invalid and never disputed
evidence: S02 vendor: deductions 2-5% of gross revenue, 1-3% invalid (REPORTED, vendor-only). S31: UK grocery invoice discrepancies 17% of suppliers
current_handling: AR analysts dispute manually via retailer portals; many small deductions written off
estimated_economic_magnitude: ESTIMATE: $10M wholesale brand → $100-300k/yr invalid (vendor range; unverified)
accessibility: Medium: brand must grant portal and ERP access; US buyers from UK operator
current_competitors_solutions: HighRadius, iNymbus, Glimpse, Vividly, Promomash, SupplyPike, Carbon6, outsourced deduction firms
why_current_solutions_may_be_insufficien: Vendors focus on large retailers and larger brands; long tail of retailers/distributors may be under-served (HYPOTHESIS)
potential_intervention_classes: Look-back dispute service; evidence packaging (POD/BOL matching); prevention analytics
major_risks: Retailer relationship; portal ToS; crowded market
strongest_argument_against: Market appears saturated in the US since 2023; no evidenced wedge for a UK solo operator; vendor-only magnitude evidence

exact_problem: Duty overpaid through misclassification, valuation errors or unclaimed tariff preferences; recoverable for 3 years
evidence: S25: 90.0% EU preference utilisation (2024); S38: 2021 exports 73%; S39 vendor: 40% codes wrong; S40: 3-yr C285 window; S33 disconfirming: 47% lines zero
current_handling: Brokers declare what they are told; few importers audit; some consultancies
estimated_economic_magnitude: UNKNOWN — key gap. Upper bound requires value of eligible-but-unused preferences on dutiable goods
measurability: Very high (HMRC repayment = verifiable cash; natural counterfactual)

major_risks: Savings persistence; low urgency after price falls
strongest_argument_against: Diagnosis is already cheap and widely offered; value per site is modest; urgency faded as prices fell from 2022 peak
